name: Carts on a track
summary: Two carts on a 10 m track with mass labels and momentum/velocity arrows; animates 1D elastic or sticky collisions.

name: Spring and mass
summary: Block on a horizontal spring with ruler and restoring-force arrow; displace it and play the oscillation.

name: Electric circuit
summary: Battery with 1–4 resistors or bulbs in series or parallel; animated charge flow, bulb brightness follows power, current/voltage labels.

name: Gas in a cylinder
summary: Cylinder with piston (volume), moving particles (amount, speed from temperature), thermometer and pressure gauge.

name: Line graph
summary: Axes with ticks, labels and up to a few line series; points can be set or added live.

name: Vector arrow
summary: Labelled arrow from a point with a length and direction; use several for force diagrams or vector addition.

name: Basic shapes
summary: Plain SVG shapes and text (rect, circle, line, path, text) for simple objects such as a ball, a block, a label or a ground line.
